shortDescription: Allows management of Keycloak realm localization overrides via the Keycloak API

options.name: auth_client_id
options.description: OpenID Connect I(client_id) to authenticate to the API with.

options.name: auth_client_secret
options.description: Client Secret to use in conjunction with I(auth_client_id) (if required).

options.name: auth_password
options.description: Password to authenticate for API access with.

options.name: auth_realm
options.description: Keycloak realm name to authenticate to for API access.

options.name: auth_username
options.description: Username to authenticate for API access with.

options.name: connection_timeout
options.description: Controls the HTTP connections timeout period (in seconds) to Keycloak API.

options.name: force
options.description: If V(false), only the keys listed in the O(overrides) are modified by this module. Any other pre-existing keys are ignored. If V(true), all locale overrides are made to match configuration of this module. For example any keys missing from the O(overrides) are removed regardless of O(state) value.

options.name: locale
options.description: Locale code for which the overrides apply (for example, V(en), V(fi), V(de)).

options.name: overrides
options.description: List of overrides to ensure for the locale when O(state=present). Each item is a mapping with the record's O(overrides[].key) and its O(overrides[].value). Ignored when O(state=absent).

options.name: parent_id
options.description: Name of the realm that owns the locale overrides.

options.name: refresh_token
options.description: Authentication refresh token for Keycloak API.

options.name: state
options.description: Desired state of localization overrides for the given locale. On V(present), the set of overrides for the locale are made to match O(overrides). If O(force) is V(true) keys not listed in O(overrides) are removed, and the listed keys are created or updated. If O(force) is V(false)  keys not listed in O(overrides) are ignored, and the listed keys are created or updated. On V(absent), overrides for the locale is removed. options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Verify TLS certificates (do not disable this in production).
